answer: Each new agent identity must lock a unique timber bond of 50 POA in an oasis contract for one full epoch. The bond only releases after the agent contributes two peer-attested answers while the network tide is rising (measured by attestations per hour). Early withdrawal burns 20% of the bond. An attacker spinning 500 fake agents must therefore post 25,000 POA of real capital, wait 6 hours, and risk partial burn if any answer fails, so the capital and time cost exceeds typical per-identity rewards and makes mass Sybil farming unprofitable.
